intentSummary: Build a URL shortener HTTP service that creates short codes for long URLs and redirects visitors from a short code to the original target. Storage is abstracted so an in-memory implementation can be swapped for a database later.

functionalRequirements.title: Create short link
functionalRequirements.description: POST /links accepts a JSON body containing a target URL and returns a generated short code plus the fully-qualified short URL.
functionalRequirements.sourceExcerpt: POST /links accepts a JSON body with a target URL and returns a short code and the short URL

functionalRequirements.title: Redirect by code
functionalRequirements.description: GET /{code} responds 302 Found redirecting to the original target URL.
functionalRequirements.sourceExcerpt: GET /{code} responds 302 redirecting to the original URL

functionalRequirements.title: Unknown code handling
functionalRequirements.description: Requests for a code that does not exist return 404 Not Found.

functionalRequirements.title: Target URL validation
functionalRequirements.description: Target URLs must be absolute http/https URLs; invalid input returns 400 with a problem description.
functionalRequirements.sourceExcerpt: target URLs must be validated as absolute http/https URLs — invalid input returns 400

functionalRequirements.title: Collision-free short codes
functionalRequirements.description: Short codes are 6-8 URL-safe characters and must be unique across existing links.
functionalRequirements.sourceExcerpt: short codes are 6–8 URL-safe characters and collision-free

functionalRequirements.title: Pluggable storage
functionalRequirements.description: Persistence is hidden behind an interface so the in-memory store can be replaced by a database without touching the API layer.
functionalRequirements.sourceExcerpt: storage may be in-memory for v1 but must be isolated behind an interface

functionalRequirements.title: Automated tests
functionalRequirements.description: Unit tests cover link creation, redirect behavior, validation failures, and unknown codes.
functionalRequirements.sourceExcerpt: include unit tests covering link creation, redirect behavior, validation failures, and unknown codes

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Technology stack
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: C# with ASP.NET minimal APIs on .NET 10, xUnit for tests, no external database, no authentication.
nonFunctionalRequirements.sourceExcerpt: C# with ASP.NET minimal APIs on .NET 10, xUnit for tests, no external database, no authentication

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Maintainability
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Storage isolated behind an interface to keep the design open for extension.
nonFunctionalRequirements.sourceExcerpt: isolated behind an interface so a database can be added later

assumptions.text: The public base URL used to build returned short URLs is configurable and defaults to the request host.
assumptions.rationale: The requirement returns a short URL but does not specify the host; deriving it from the request is the least surprising default.

assumptions.text: Short codes are generated at random from a URL-safe alphabet with a retry on the rare collision.
assumptions.rationale: Random generation with a uniqueness check satisfies both the collision-free and URL-safe constraints without external coordination.
